articles.headline: Ivory Coast vs. Norway - Kick-off time, team news, how to watch as Diomande faces Haaland
articles.description: Ivory Coast will take on Norway in a FIFA World Cup round of 32 clash in Arlington, Texas on Tuesday as one of world football's rising stars, Yan Diomande, faces a team featuring the likes of Erling Haaland and Martin Ødegaard.

articles.headline: Why outsiders believe the USMNT can make a deep World Cup run
articles.description: After an impressive group stage, ESPN has assembled a panel of coaches and analysts to assess whether the United States has what it takes to become the surprise package of the 2026 FIFA World Cup.

articles.headline: What Bafana Bafana need to level up after World Cup exit
articles.description: South Africa's World Cup can end with pride, as Hugo Broos's side reached the knockout stages for the first time in history, having overcoming an early setback with the opening defeat by Mexico in the process.

articles.headline: Jiménez is lucky to be alive, never mind living his World Cup dream
articles.description: Six years after suffering a life-threatening skull fracture, Raúl Jiménez is back at the top, leading Mexico at this World Cup on home soil.
